implementation_summary: Rejected agent self-report and reflection sources before experience persistence and before canonical records can feed distillation.
Extended recurrence reports with metrics, top repeated mistakes, diagnostics, operator feedback, and badge-ready fields derived from canonical experience records.
Rendered the same backtest feedback in local HTML reports and interactive CLI output while preserving JSON automation behavior.
Marked generated memory rules with verified-outcome memory-source metadata and documented the schema/docs changes.
